Education Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 6–8 years of relevant experience, with deep expertise in at least two Digital Workforce–relevant domains (digital employee experience, Microsoft 365, automation, or security). Deep, hands-on expertise in at least two of the following: digital employee experience platform architecture, the Microsoft 365 and Copilot ecosystem, automation and scripting, or security and compliance integration. Demonstrated ability to design cross-system architecture and set technical standards adopted by other engineers, without formal people-management authority. Advanced experience with enterprise digital employee experience platforms (for example, Nexthink), including telemetry pipeline design and integration with IT service management and endpoint toolchains. Expert-level Microsoft 365 and Copilot administration knowledge, including enterprise governance and access-control design. Strong track record partnering with Information Security, Vendor Management, and cross-functional stakeholders on complex, ambiguous technical evaluations. Effective mentor to less-senior engineers on architecture and evaluation decisions; comfortable operating as an informal technical lead. WORK ENVIRONMENT This is a hybrid position. review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer - Streams - Observability
review_candidates.description: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. What is The Role: The Observability Streams team at Elastic is building Elastic's unified data pipeline - the layer that connects where your data comes from to where it lands, with full control over how it's processed and routed along the way. Whether you're collecting metrics from cloud accounts, shipping logs from agents, or routing traces to different destinations, Streams is what ties it all together. The Streams Backend team is responsible for the backend services powering this pipeline, ensuring data is routed, processed, and delivered efficiently and reliably at scale. We also own Logstash, the open-source streaming ETL tool (and the “L” in the “ELK stack”) trusted by enterprises worldwide to move and transform data, and we are regular contributors to the OpenTelemetry Collector. As a Senior software engineer on the Streams Backend team, you will help drive the design and development of new features across the Streams Backend service and Logstash, contribute to the OpenTelemetry Collector, and support our users and enterprise customers. Our team is distributed across the globe, and we communicate mostly through Slack, GitHub, email and Zoom. What You Will Be Doing: Designing and implementing new features for Logstash and its plugins in Java and JRuby. Designing, building, and operating core backend services for the Streams program in Golang. Adding new features, and making contributions to the Open Telemetry Collector in Golang. Solving hard distributed systems problems at scale. Maintaining, updating and improving existing code and dependencies while ensuring automated test coverage. Engaging with multiple public GitHub repositories and community forums. Providing Pull Request reviews and guidance to your peers. Collaborating with other teams to drive product goals. Working together with the support organization to help our customers, which will also include participating in an on-call rotation. What You Bring: Ability to work in a remote-first, highly distributed environment, with top-notch verbal and written communication. Proficient analytical, problem solving, debugging skills and ability to find efficient solutions. Critical thinking, positivity, autonomy and adaptability. Expertise in at least one of Java, Golang and Ruby, and willingness to learn and work with the others and ability to adapt to regularly working in different codebases. Clear written communication and the ability to work proficiently in a remote-first, highly distributed team. A proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes. Bonus Points: Familiarity with observability tools and concepts (tracing, metrics, logging), especially experience with or interest in OpenTelemetry Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. JRuby development Open source software development Knowledge of stream processing platforms (such as Kafka), database technologies (e.g., Postgres or MySQL) and network technologies (e.g., TCP, UDP and HTTP). Exposure to the Elastic stack. Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People: As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do. We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do. Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary Health coverage for you and your family in many locations Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles Generous number of vacation days each year Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave Security & Privacy Responsibilities: Take ownership of protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational data and systems by following applicable privacy and security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure that all individual contributions follow Elastic’s Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). Proactively participate in mandatory role-based training to ensure personal technical execution consistently aligns with the highest standards of data protection, data privacy, and system resilience. Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation. We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission. Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws and can view the following posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster Elasticsearch develops and distributes technology and information that is subject to U.S. and other countries’ export controls and licensing requirements for individuals who are located in or are nationals of the following sanctioned countries and regions: Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, or Russia, including the Ukrainian territories annexed by Russia (The Crimea region of Ukraine, The Donetsk People's Republic (DNR), The Luhansk People's Republic (LNR), Kherson or Zaporizhzhia). If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Please note that national origin and/or nationality do not affect eligibility for employment with Elastic. Please see here for our Privacy Statement. Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. review_candidates.title: Staff Full Stack Engineer - Sell Side Engine
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Full Stack Engineer - Sell Side Engine based in Germany. This is a highly hands-on Staff Engineer role focused on solving complex technical problems within a rapidly scaling energy technology environment. You will join a small, high-impact product squad responsible for rebuilding the systems that support renewable energy origination, contracting, onboarding, and growth. The role combines deep backend and systems engineering with the flexibility to contribute to frontend development when needed. You will make architecture-level decisions across integration-heavy systems, working with pricing, data, billing, and risk platforms. A major focus will be turning manual and error-prone commercial processes into scalable, automated products that can support new business categories. You will work with significant autonomy, operating within ambiguity and taking complex problems from definition through production delivery. This is an opportunity for an exceptional engineer to directly influence critical market infrastructure while helping build the technology behind a more transparent and efficient energy ecosystem. Accountabilities Own architecture-level decisions for complex, integration-heavy systems, clearly defining system boundaries, contracts, dependencies, and failure modes. Design and build the technical foundations connecting new-product initiatives with pricing, settlement, data, billing, and other core platforms. Take commercially driven and sometimes ambiguous problems, define practical technical approaches, and turn them into shippable plans within the squad's strategic direction. Help develop and launch new product categories, contributing to the technical work required to bring new offerings from concept through production and qualified commercial pipeline. Automate and productise tendering, pricing, contracting, onboarding, and other manual workflows that currently limit scalability and create operational risk. Design deal-gating and risk-management tooling that enables the business to safely support new categories of commercial risk. Work effectively across organizational boundaries, delivering integrations and technical outcomes that depend on teams you do not directly manage. Build high-quality software across backend services and, when appropriate, contribute to React and TypeScript frontend development. Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code, participate actively in code reviews, and contribute to stronger engineering practices and documentation. Help measure and improve the reliability, scalability, and business impact of the systems you build. Requirements Deep technical expertise in backend engineering and systems design, with a proven track record of making architecture-level decisions for complex, integration-heavy systems. Strong professional experience with Python and AWS serverless technologies, including Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and EventBridge. Solid understanding of event-driven architectures and distributed systems. Full Stack or Backend Engineering experience in a startup, scale-up, or fast-paced product environment, with ownership of complex projects from inception through delivery. Ability to work effectively without a complete specification, turning an ambiguous problem into a practical, well-scoped, and shippable technical plan. Demonstrated experience delivering projects where critical dependencies are owned by other teams, requiring strong collaboration and influence without direct authority. Strong product mindset and ability to connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes and customer or business value. Comfortable working hands-on across the stack, with React and TypeScript experience considered a plus rather than a core requirement. Strong engineering judgment, attention to quality, and ability to reason about scalability, reliability, system boundaries, and failure modes. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working across technical and organizational boundaries. Experience mentoring engineers or setting technical direction is desirable but not required. Experience in energy, fintech, or another regulated or high-stakes commercial environment is advantageous. Exposure to workflow orchestration, real-time pricing engines, or event-driven systems is a plus. Experience creating new product lines or technical capabilities from scratch is highly desirable. Benefits Competitive base salary of £104,000, or the equivalent in local currency. Compensation benchmarked against role and level, with pay adjustments based on demonstrated evidence rather than a fixed annual review cycle. Stock options, providing employees with ownership in the long-term success of the business. 25 days of annual holiday plus public holidays, with the flexibility to exchange public holidays for alternative days that are more meaningful to you. Additional day off for your birthday. Fully remote and flexible working environment with clear core hours. No internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Up to £1,200 / €1,200 annually for home-working and remote setup expenses, including equipment and coworking passes. Up to £150 / €150 per month for wellbeing expenses, which can be used for options such as therapy, gym memberships, or meditation apps. Inclusive environment welcoming people from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and identities. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
